I’m not connected to live data feeds, so I can’t tell you the exact match that’s scheduled for today.

**Quick way to find out:**

1. **Official IPL site** – https://www.iplt20.com/  
   → “Fixtures” tab shows the full schedule with dates, times, and venues.

2. **Cricbuzz** – https://www.cricbuzz.com/ipl  
   → “Schedule” section lists all matches for the current season.

3. **ESPN Cricinfo** – https://www.espncricinfo.com/series/ipl-2024-1258425  
   → “Schedule” tab gives the same information.

If you’re looking for a specific match (e.g., which teams are playing, venue, start time), just open one of those sites or search “IPL fixtures today” in your browser. That will give you the most up‑to‑date information.
